analysis:
The only change in this file is a one-line test helper edit at line 312, `case .toolCall:` becoming `case .toolCall, .toolCallDelta:`. It sits inside the test-only `recordServerStream` event-collection function. This change only keeps the test switch exhaustive after a new `.toolCallDelta` event case was added to `MLXServerGenerationEvent` elsewhere in the PR. The supplied units (base lines 1221-2472) contain no changed lines; they are surrounding unchanged tests.

These tests cover tool-choice enforcement (fail-closed post-validation, parser mismatch rejection, multimodal rejection), cacheScope/cacheSalt plumbing (T-041 salt scoping), cancellation propagation, and heartbeat capacity. The test helper change does not weaken any production control.

The only integration question is in production code outside this batch. The new `.toolCallDelta` streaming event may emit tool-call fragments before validation. That could bypass the existing fail-closed behavior for forced `tool_choice`, where the tests expect `emitted.isEmpty` on violation. I could not verify this from the supplied evidence. The test helper silently drops `.toolCallDelta`, so these tests will not detect a regression if deltas leak before validation. Reviewers of the production streaming code should check that deltas cannot expose unvalidated or forced-tool-choice-violating content. This is a coverage observation, not a finding.

No threat-model assets, trust boundaries or mitigations are affected by this test-only change.
